test_title: PYST 07: SSC JE EE - General Intelligence (Held on 05 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: L, M, N, O, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). M is sitting to the immediate right of Q. L is sitting to the immediate left of O. Q is sitting to the immediate right of O. P is sitting to the immediate left of L. Who is sitting to the immediate right of M?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) M is sitting to the immediate right of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e549f0c3428c6e7a6d0f536e3f8da8a6f2cf4eeaaafbd80977cf5c655079daf2.png] 

2) Q is sitting to the immediate right of O.

3) L is sitting to the immediate left of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8abd4081c9f20a24bd63dc2ed9fbe521f70f946947df070bdb47722c73f62b1.png] 

4) P is sitting to the immediate left of L. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6a81bf071f95ea8c30f30004c656c76f91d5f27eaaba3d28dec89e2514e40ec.png] 

Here, we can see that 'N' is sitting to the immediate right of M.

Hence, the correct answer is **"N"**.
